name: Sika AnchorFix® Flexible Extensions
summary: Sika AnchorFix® Flexible Extensions is a flexible tube and used as an extension of the nozzle / static mixer to apply AnchorFix® into deep drill holes.
metaDescription: Sika AnchorFix® Flexible Extensions is a flexible tube and used as an extension of the nozzle / static mixer to apply AnchorFix® into deep drill holes.
packaging: Bag of 2 pieces with 1000 mm length tube Bag of 5 pieces with 300 mm length tube Bag of 10 pieces with 300 mm length tube

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text: Flexible extensions are referenced in the corresponding approvals of each Sika AnchorFix® product

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions. Always refer to packaging.

rel.s: Sika AnchorFix® Hole Cleaning Brushes Steel is a brush to clean drill hole sizes of Ø12mm to Ø55mm for Sika AnchorFix® applications.
